requirement.description: The NotifyResend.__init__() method is missing the 'from_email' argument in its constructor, causing a TypeError when trying to instantiate the plugin with required parameters.
requirement.contract: The NotifyResend.__init__() method should accept 'from_email' as a required parameter and properly initialize the from_email attribute.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin URL parsing fails when parsing paths with user and group targets, resulting in incorrect privacy URL generation and target resolution.
requirement.contract: The Nextcloud plugin should correctly parse user/group targets from URL paths and generate proper privacy URLs with proper encoding.

requirement.description: The SendGrid plugin incorrectly handles notifications with bad email addresses, returning True instead of False when notification fails due to invalid email.
requirement.contract: The SendGrid plugin should return False when attempting to send notification to invalid email addresses.

requirement.description: The Slack plugin's __init__ method doesn't properly initialize the access_token parameter when using the access_token parameter, causing TypeError when accessing the access_token attribute.
requirement.contract: The Slack plugin should properly initialize access_token parameter in __init__ method to avoid AttributeError.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin's send() method doesn't properly handle empty targets list, leading to incorrect behavior when no targets are specified.
requirement.contract: The Nextcloud plugin should return False with appropriate warning when no targets are specified in send() method.
